name: Elsmere Ironworks
old_description: Wouldn't a quality, exterior hand railing or fencing be a nice addition to enhance your property? How about updating your interior railings? We give free estimates and offer a variety of designs and styles. Or work with one of our CAD designers to create a unique and totally custom design for your home. Contact us for your next project!
about:
Elsmere Ironworks has operated from Elsmere, Kentucky, since 1958. The family-owned shop was purchased in 2023 by Ryan Work from longtime owners John and Dan Goderwis, continuing a legacy of custom ornamental ironwork for the Tri-State region.

The company fabricates exterior and interior railings, estate gates, fencing, balconies, window boxes, wine gates, and security features for windows and doors. Its workshop combines old-world forging techniques with modern welding, powder coating, custom faux finishes, and hot-dipped galvanizing. A showroom at 600 Lytle Avenue allows clients to review samples and collaborate with CAD designers on custom projects.

Elsmere Ironworks serves residential and commercial customers across Greater Cincinnati, Northern Kentucky, and Southern Indiana. Homeowners request railings, gates, and decorative accents, while commercial projects include security installations and architectural metalwork.

The firm emphasizes durable finishes — powder coating baked in an oven for ten times the durability of paint, and hot-dipped galvanizing rated for 70-plus years of corrosion resistance — backed by a one-year paint warranty. It also stresses on-time delivery and free estimates.
